meta.note: Vectors are copied from the official sources unchanged; see kat/SOURCES.md

sources.name: NIST CAVP GCM test vectors (CAVS 14.0): gcmEncryptExtIV256.rsp, gcmDecrypt256.rsp in gcmtestvectors.zip

rsa_oaep_decrypt.description: RSAES-OAEP, RSA-3072, SHA-256, MGF1-SHA-256. valid: must decrypt to msg; invalid: must be rejected

aes256_gcm.description: AES-256-GCM, 96-bit IV, 128-bit tag: encrypt must give ct and tag; decrypt must give pt

aes256_gcm_reject.description: AES-256-GCM authentication must FAIL (NIST gcmDecrypt256.rsp FAIL cases)
